Identidad estable
relations.reading: A stable object identity can support several operational views without collapsing their distinct permissions and responsibilities.

relations.title: Transferencia de contexto
relations.reading: The Japan case offers an organizational comparison for context-preserving handoffs between distinct decision owners.

relations.title: Capacidad efectiva de respuesta
relations.reading: Decision authority and timely review capacity should be specified separately in the governance contract.

relations.title: Propuesta y compromiso
relations.reading: A proposal–reservation–authorization–commitment sequence could clarify the authority boundary of piece allocation.

relations.title: Explicación trazable
relations.reading: The GEPLAN interface illustrates why human authority needs usable decision context, not merely a confirmation button.

relations.title: Recuperación por similitud
relations.reading: Similarity can help retrieve product knowledge, but currency, evidential scope and authority must be qualified separately before it supports an operational commitment.

relations.title: Transferencia de contexto
relations.reading: Shared mission accountability does not erase the distinct authority conditions that must accompany a handoff between operational owners.

relations.title: Observabilidad del proceso
relations.reading: Better observation of an urban service does not by itself grant the authority to change an operator's commitments.

relations.title: Transferencia de contexto
relations.reading: The contracting vehicle, decision owner and execution platform remain distinct even when they participate in the same operational handoff.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: A governance principle becomes operational when it specifies an owner, an escalation condition and a clear boundary on authorized action.

relations.title: Transferencia de contexto
relations.reading: Voluntary cooperation can preserve each participant's knowledge limits and decision rights while making shared action more intelligible.

relations.title: Función federada de integridad
relations.reading: An integrity function can coordinate common decision conditions while retaining the distinct authority and expertise of its constituent disciplines.

relations.title: Evidencia de contribución
relations.reading: Compressed accountability should not become concentrated blame without matching authority or visible contribution.

relations.title: Frontera de integridad operacional
relations.reading: The mission contract can make requalification explicit when changed evidence or operating conditions alter the boundary of accountable action.

relations.title: Liberación y análisis causal
relations.reading: Leverage-point selection can focus mission activation, but neither a perspective workshop nor an activation ritual substitutes for explicit authority and closure conditions.

relations.title: Acoplamiento selectivo entre sistemas
relations.reading: Selective coupling becomes an actionable design question only when authority, escalation, operating limits and exit conditions are explicit at the interface.

relations.title: Legitimidad en ambos lados de una interfaz
relations.reading: Legitimacy on both sides of a boundary can enable translation, but it does not itself grant authority to commit either side.

relations.title: Propuesta y compromiso
relations.reading: A peer agent’s assertion of permission should be tested against the actual authority boundary and action contract, not treated as authorization in itself.

relations.title: Identidad estable
relations.reading: Identity and contract lineage should remain distinct from the authority currently applicable to an action across entities and jurisdictions.

relations.title: Compresión y expansión de la intervención
relations.reading: Phase changes can be reviewed as role and mandate transitions, distinguishing permitted realignment from a new objective or contract.

relations.title: Propuesta y compromiso
relations.reading: A mobility orchestration design can distinguish recommendation, reservation, commitment and execution, with material changes triggering the appropriate requalification or confirmation.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: A candidate goal or useful finding does not enlarge a Tiger Team’s mandate; adoption, authority and participation conditions must be explicit.

relations.title: Valor descubierto
relations.reading: Event intelligence may reveal a valuable opportunity while action remains outside the current mandate; preserving the finding and authorizing the campaign are separate steps.

relations.title: Capacidad humana utilizable
relations.reading: Human accountability requires effective intervention capacity as well as authority; a nominal approval does not repair an unsupported or time-expired decision.

relations.title: Existencia, encuentro y oportunidad ejecutable
relations.reading: Chosen solidarity needs an admissible transition with resources and consent, not merely a desirable end state or an aggregate score.

relations.title: Orden parcial de dimensiones no fungibles
relations.reading: Chosen solidarity can include an explicitly accepted trade-off; an analyst should not erase that choice by collapsing nonfungible dimensions into a universal score.
